defaults.notes: Reference baselines are stdlib-only harness strategies intended for transparent comparison, not strong task performance.

baselines.description: Injects no memories and measures the task's no-memory floor.
Selects a small set of shortest candidate memories while only weakly preferring valid items.
Restricts retrieval to valid session-tier memories to expose failures from missing project and long-term context.
Ranks candidates with a fixed tier and bucket heuristic to provide a transparent non-LLM tier-aware baseline.
